description: Complexity-to-model mapping and override rules for the customer service optimization pipeline.

tier_thresholds.description: Composite score ranges for baseline tier assignment before any overrides.

dimension_weights.description: Weights used to compute weighted_composite_score from the six complexity dimensions.

safety_critical_override.description: Tasks flagged safety_critical=true or safety_criticality >= 7 are subject to minimum model floor.
safety_critical_override.note: Safety-critical tasks cannot be routed to Haiku regardless of composite score or budget pressure.

reasoning_depth_direct_override.description: reasoning_depth alone can force a tier floor, independent of composite score.
reasoning_depth_direct_override.note: Composite score can still upgrade within the tier, but cannot drop below the floor set by reasoning_depth.

confidence_threshold_rule.description: When classifier confidence is below threshold, escalate to Sonnet minimum.
confidence_threshold_rule.note: Applies after composite scoring and safety overrides. Prevents silent misclassification of ambiguous tasks.

budget_pressure_rules.description: Override rules activated by budget_utilization percentage from BudgetGovernor.

tiers.label: nominal
tiers.description: Routing operates on complexity scores alone. No budget overrides applied.

tiers.label: elevated
tiers.description: Downgrade one tier (opus→sonnet, sonnet→haiku) for tasks where safety_criticality < 7. Audit log entry required for each downgrade.
tiers.exemption: safety_criticality >= 7 — these tasks retain their complexity-based assignment

tiers.label: critical
tiers.description: All tasks forced to Haiku unless safety_criticality >= 7, in which case Sonnet floor is maintained.
tiers.exemption: safety_criticality >= 7 — floor is Sonnet, not Haiku

budget_pressure_rules.note: Budget overrides are applied after confidence threshold check. Safety override always wins over budget pressure.

escalation_policy.description: Automatic escalation when a quality gate reports insufficient output quality.

triggers.description: Downstream verifier flags output as below quality threshold.
Model self-reports low confidence in its output.
Verifier detects that the response lacked required inferential depth.

calibration_feedback.description: If escalation_rate for a task_type exceeds threshold, promote that type's default tier in routing policy.

customer_service_step_type_defaults.description: Pre-classified tier defaults for known customer service step types. Override with live scoring when complexity hints are present.

change_log.change: Initial policy creation. Thresholds based on offline evaluation on 200 labeled tasks.
change_log.author: ModelRouter v1.0
